_doc: Per-weapon bullet damage (SPEC 6), read by src/damage_model.cpp. damage(r) = lerp(near, far, smoothstep(falloffStart_m, falloffEnd_m, r)) x zone, r = the distance the round actually travelled; no falloff when start == end. Zones: head = the weapon's headMult, upper torso (mid-spine to neck) 1.0, lower torso (hips to mid-spine) 0.9, arms and legs 0.65. Helmets do not reduce damage (metal sound + sparks only). 'rpm' is reference only (the fire rate lives in content/weapons/<id>.json); rows use the repo's own RPMs and keep the SPEC 6.2 shots-to-kill bands (asserted by --selftest-rules). 'dataOnly' rows have no model in the repo yet (owner decision). 'note' documents rows that are not in the SPEC table.

decisions._doc: SPEC 6.2 [DECISION] defaults, one value each. kar98kLimbMult: limb multiplier of the rows that reference it (0.65 = 2 limb shots; >= 0.67 = one hit anywhere). springfieldProfile: 'brief' (one shot up close, 2 beyond ~150 m) or 'kar98k' (no falloff, 150 at any range).

default.note: fallback for an unlisted bullet weapon

kar98k.note: [DECISION] decisions.kar98kLimbMult: limb hits take 2 shots (150 x 0.65 = 97.5)

kar98k_zf39.note: Kar98k sniper (ZF39): same row as the Kar98k, same [DECISION] value

m1903a4.note: M1903A4 Springfield. [DECISION] decisions.springfieldProfile: the brief as written (one shot up close, 2 beyond ~150 m); 'kar98k' gives it the no-falloff profile

m1c_garand.note: not in SPEC 6.2: the sniper Garand keeps the M1 Garand row, as the Kar98k sniper keeps the Kar98k row

fg42.note: not in SPEC 6.2: full-power 7.92x57 at 750 rpm slots into the MG 42 band (torso 3/3/3/3, limbs 4/4, close TTK 160 ms)

m2hb_carry.note: not in SPEC 6.2: .50 BMG heavy MG slots into the Springfield band (torso 1/1/1/2, limbs 2/2); its weight and deploy time are the balance
